description: This script sets up a PostgreSQL database environment for a project by creating extensions, tables, constraints, and indexes. It sources environment variables from local files if not present in the environment, then executes a series of SQL commands via psql. It includes checks for environment variable presence, and aims to be idempotent.

methods.name: main execution flow
methods.description: Sequentially executes SQL commands to set up database schema and constraints, with environment variable handling and error checking.

calls: eval ${PSQL} -c "CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pgcrypto;"
eval ${PSQL} -c "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.teams ..."
eval ${PSQL} -c "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.profiles ..."
eval ${PSQL} -c "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.weekly_reports ..."
